tracking_rule.formula: clip(current_state - source_plan[age_actions-1], -0.1, 0.1), broadcast to four slots; age>0, valid tail, arm dimensions excluding 6/13
tracking_rule.caveat: current_state is on the expert offline trajectory; source_plan was not executed; not online policy effectiveness evidence
